QF.id: AIFM CIII Fee Structure and Fund Performance_32

question.text: What is the regulatory concentration limit for a Cat III AIF (open-ended) per SEBI, with respect to investment in a single investee company?

explanation.text: The Logic: Category III AIFs may invest up to 10% of their investable funds in a single investee company. A higher 20% limit applies for schemes raised entirely from large-value accredited investors. The Trap: 5% is too strict; 25% does not match the Cat III investee-company limit set out in the workbook; 35% is fabricated. Note: The 10% limit is on a single investee company, measured against the scheme's investable funds.
